points.quote: the use of Generative AI is permitted unless otherwise stated in course and module handbooks, or in module descriptions in the Blackboard VLE.
points.gist: GenAI use is permitted unless course or module handbooks, or Blackboard module descriptions, say otherwise.

points.quote: However, you must (at a minimum) acknowledge its use, using the guidance given in this LibGuide.
points.gist: Students must at minimum acknowledge GenAI use, following the LibGuide guidance.

points.quote: GenAI is evolving rapidly and there is not yet general consensus on how to acknowledge and reference it. This guidance will therefore continue to be reviewed and updated.
points.gist: Guidance on acknowledging and referencing GenAI will keep being reviewed and updated.
